definitions.ask: Should a Task Card key swallowed by the review-walk settle lock show a short notice?
definitions.why: A silent swallow looks exactly like a broken keymap, which is this bug report

choices.label: Key is still swallowed, but a toast says "press Alt+P again"; double presses show it too
Stays silent; a fast press right after a landing still looks like a broken key

definitions.ask: Should the fix ship with a committed real-Obsidian regression e2e for Alt+P?
definitions.why: Unit stubs never evaluate CSS, which is how the invisible card shipped with green tests

choices.label: Commit a real-Obsidian e2e plus offline self-test in npm test, like the decay-ladder e2e
Verify once in a throwaway run; commit only unit tests
